subject: Competitive coverage structuring and license wrangling
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@frostai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & packaging — can Redwood match our incumbent?

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from FrostAI — we're evaluating replacement options for our inference stack and would like a sense of whether Redwood can provide:

- A price match / near-price parity vs our current vendor (IncumbentAI). Current blended effective rate: ~$0.0068/token for our 3M monthly tokens (mix of chat + embeddings).
- A packaging option for a 12-month pilot that includes a modest onboarding credit and a reserve for burst capacity.
- Clarity on licensing (are we buying seat-like reserved capacity, or purely consumption?), and any constraints on model variants/quantized runtimes for the matched rate.
- Data residency & audit logs — they are sensitive to EU customers; we have a handful of EU tenants.

We'd love a short proposal by EOD Thursday if possible. I can share our current SOW and usage export (attached).

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Platform, FrostAI
elaine@frostai.com
Attachment: FrostAI_current_sow.pdf (reference)

Subject: Fwd: Pricing & packaging — can Redwood match our incumbent?

Looping you both in — FrostAI (Elaine) sent the note below. Key asks: price parity on blended rate, 12-month pilot packaging with onboarding credit, reserve for bursts, and EU residency/audit logs.

Immediate ask: can we put together a concise counter (1 pager + cost calc) that preserves gross margin while being competitive?

Constraints to consider:
- We should avoid a long-term license transfer; prefer a reserved-capacity bucket + consumption overage.
- Offer quantized runtime option for 10-15% additional savings but flag potential model variant quality delta.
- Consider 20% onboarding credit applied to first 90 days vs a flat dollar credit.

Kimberly — can you validate whether our EU region SLAs and audit exports meet their ask?
Lauren — can you run a quick cost projection (attach runtime-cost-projection.xlsx) for a 12-month pilot at parity + a 15% blended discount scenario?

I'll draft language for the external email once we have numbers.

— Vivek
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:26:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Pricing & packaging — can Redwood match our incumbent?

Vivek / Kim —

Quick run of the numbers and recommended structure below (attached: runtime-cost-projection.xlsx). High level: we can achieve near-parity with a blended effective rate at $0.0069/token under a 12-month pilot if we combine reserved buckets + a modest onboarding credit. Details: 

Proposal (12-month pilot):
- Reserved baseline: commit to 2.5M tokens/month at a blended reserved rate equivalent to $0.0058/token.
- Consumption overage: billed at $0.0075/token.
- Onboarding credit: 20% credit applied to first 90 days of billed usage (not to exceed $40k).
- Burst reserve: short-term burst capacity (up to 30% of baseline) available for two scheduled events/month at no extra ramp fee; extra bursts billed at on-demand rate.
- Quantized runtime option: offer an additional 12% discount on tokens run on the quantized path; include an explicit quality disclaimer in the SOW.

Legal / contract notes to flag:
- No license transfer; we propose a standard usage/reserved capacity agreement with a 30-day termination after the pilot period with a limited wind-down credit schedule.
- Data residency: we can guarantee EU region hosting for EU tenants; audit logs export conforms to our SOC2 report (we should attach SOC2 summary).
- IP & model custody: we cannot accept vendor-side model escrow demands; we can offer a technical handoff plan for requested artifacts.

Margin impact: at the capped $40k onboarding credit our blended gross margin remains acceptable (~42%) for the pilot. If they push for a $100k buyout, margin drops into low 30s — requires approval.

Next steps:
1) Vivek — send the customer the high-level proposal + the attached cost sheet and FrostAI_SOW_v1.pdf.
2) If they accept, route to legal for a lightweight SOW with the quantization opt-in checkbox.

Attachment: runtime-cost-projection.xlsx (spreadsheet)

— Lauren
Senior Manager, Deals
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Competitive proposal for FrostAI — 12mo pilot (summary)

Elaine —

Thanks for the SOW and the usage snapshot. Putting our recommended approach in one place so your team can react quickly. If you’d like, we can follow up with a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk the numbers.

Summary proposal (12-month pilot):
- Baseline reservation: 2.5M tokens/month at an effective reserved rate that yields $0.0058/token.
- Overage: $0.0075/token.
- Onboarding credit: 20% applied to first 90 days of billed usage, capped at $40,000.
- Burst reserve: two scheduled burst windows/month (up to 30% baseline); unscheduled bursts billed at on-demand rates.
- Quantized runtime: optional at -12% token cost with explicit quality/variance flag (we’ll provide acceptance tests).
- EU data residency & audit logs: supported; we will provide SOC2 summary and an audit export template.

Why this structure: it lets FrostAI get nearly the same effective economics as your incumbent while preserving our ability to deliver model variants and fallback routing without permanent license transfers. It also gives a clear upgrade path to Dedicated capacity if you grow.

Next steps:
1) If this looks acceptable, please tell us if you prefer the credit applied as a dollar cap or as a percentage over the first 90 days.
2) We’ll push a draft SOW to DocuSign and loop your legal for redlines.

Attached: FrostAI_SOW_v1.pdf, runtime-cost-projection.xlsx

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
